Summary: Worship is God's people ascribing worth to Him in spirit and in truth, in song, prayer, obedience, and everyday life offered as a living sacrifice. From Abraham's altars to the Psalms to the heavenly throne room in Revelation, worship is heaven's activity breaking into earth. True worship centres on who God is and what He has done in Christ.
KeyPassages: Genesis 22:5; Psalm 95:6; Psalm 100:1-5; John 4:23-24; Romans 12:1; Revelation 5:12-13
RelatedEvents: Binding of Isaac; Building of Solomon's Temple; Pentecost
